name: throw-snowball-down20
about: Траектория брошенного snowball: взгляд 20°, на месте. Сверка по тактам: появление, скорость, сдвиги.

random.name: north-facing launch yaw from random X sign
random.why: vanilla-throw-snowball-flat.json has vx=+0.001343 and yaw=127; vanilla-throw-snowball-walk/ender_pearl-flat have vx<0 and yaw=-128. atan2 uses noisy launch direction before inherited motion; these adjacent byte values are random, not a fixed wrap correction. No movement, timing or position tolerance.

random.name: down20 launch pitch straddles byte boundary
random.why: The scenario passes 20 radians, not degrees. Vanilla velocity (-0.009888,1.381554,-0.600989) implies byte 47; ours (-0.007935,1.352500,-0.608191) implies 46. Both lie within measured launch spread. Their +10 velocities are replay-tested separately, not masked.
